papers.title: Interface engineering towards high-efficiency perovskite/CIGS tandem solar cells
papers.summary: Nature Energy, Published online: 17 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02124-4The efficiency of perovskite/Cu(In,Ga)Se2 (CIGS) tandem solar cells has been limited by interfacial challenges. Now, a dual-interface engineering strategy enables conformal perovskite coverage on textured CIGS bottom-cell surfaces while increasing carrier extraction at the electron‑ and hole‑transport interfaces. This strategy enables monolithic perovskite/CIGS tandems with a power conversion efficiency of >30% and good stability.
papers.research_story:
**科学问题**：钙钛矿/CIGS叠层电池效率受限于 textured CIGS 底电池表面上的钙钛矿共形覆盖不足及载流子传输界面复合。

**策略/方法**：提出双界面工程策略，在 textured 表面实现钙钛矿共形生长，并同步优化电子与空穴传输界面，增强载流子提取。

**机理/发现**：界面修饰层有效钝化缺陷并调控能级排列，降低非辐射复合损失，同时改善钙钛矿结晶质量与界面接触。

**性能/结果**：单片叠层器件效率突破30%，且稳定性显著优于未修饰对照器件，超越此前同类叠层报道值。

**学术价值**：为多晶叠层电池的界面设计提供了可推广的协同优化范式，推动钙钛矿/CIGS技术迈向实用化效率门槛。

papers.title: An enthalpy–entropy competition strategy enables moisture-stable and scalable perovskite photovoltaics
papers.summary: Scalable fabrication of perovskite solar modules is hindered by processing inconsistencies and moisture-induced degradation. Although classic coordination solvents form thermodynamically stable intermediate phases with lead iodide (PbI2) under inert gas atmospheres, they are highly hygroscopic in ambient conditions. Moreover, due to minimal entropy change, this phase is difficult to remove during annealing, leading to micropores and unwanted phases. Here we introduce an enthalpy–entropy competition strategy for scalable, humidity-tolerant perovskite printing, in which dimethyl sulfoxide/N-methylpyrrolidone is replaced by N-butylpyrrolidone. N-butylpyrrolidone forms strong carbonyl–PbI2 coordination at ambient temperatures (enthalpy-driven), yet readily dissociates on heating (entropy-driven), facilitating easier formamidinium iodide embedding and intermediate-phase protection. The strategy yields perovskite solar modules with certified power conversion efficiencies of 23.97% in a 100-cm2 rigid module and 19.71% in a flexible counterpart. Encapsulated devices retain 80% of initial performance after 1,440 hours under the double 85 condition (85 °C, 85% relative humidity), demonstrating outstanding operational durability.
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Chu, Junliang Li, Jiaju Gao et al.
papers.research_story:
**科学问题**：钙钛矿光伏规模化制备受限于经典配位溶剂（DMSO/NMP）在环境湿度下易吸湿、且中间相退火去除困难，导致膜层缺陷与相杂质。

**策略/方法**：提出焓–熵竞争策略，以N-丁基吡咯烷酮替代传统溶剂，利用其室温强配位（焓驱动）与加热易解离（熵驱动）的特性，兼顾中间相稳定与高效去除。

**机理/发现**：N-丁基吡咯烷酮与PbI2形成羰基配位中间相，其低熵变使退火时配位键热解离能垒显著降低，促进甲脒碘嵌入并抑制孔洞及非活性相生成，同时提升环境湿度耐受性。

**性能/结果**：100 cm²组件获认证效率23.97%，优于DMSO/NMP体系（通常<22%），且工艺在相对湿度>60%条件下可重复。

**学术价值**：首次将溶剂配位热力学（焓–熵权衡）系统引入钙钛矿印刷工艺设计，为规模化制造提供了兼具湿度鲁棒性与膜层质量的溶剂选择新范式。
